# Prodigy Media

Prodigy Media is a premium digital agency based in Mumbai, India. We engineer high-performance websites, custom software, digital branding systems, and data-driven marketing campaigns for ambitious global brands.

## Core Pages
- **Home** (https://www.prodigymedia.in): Overview of services, core technologies, and active client partnerships.
- **About** (https://www.prodigymedia.in/about): Background on our technical development stack, engineering philosophy, and creative direction.
- **Services** (https://www.prodigymedia.in/services): Breakdown of our premium services, packages, pricing tiers, and project onboarding workflows.
- **Contact** (https://www.prodigymedia.in/contact): Inquiries, office maps, WhatsApp links, and forms for project architecture consultations.

## Services Breakdown

### 1. Digital Marketing & Performance SEO
Comprehensive growth campaigns targeting search optimization (SEO), social ad creative suites, performance tracking analytics, and B2B LinkedIn/PPC positioning.

### 2. Software Development & Web Apps
Custom enterprise-grade software development. Our technical stack includes Next.js, React, Node.js, TypeScript, React Native, and robust AWS cloud architectures.

### 3. Personal Branding
Executive personal branding and authority building using AI content systems for founders, creators, and corporate leaders.

### 4. Brand Identity & Logo Design
Corporate identity packages, logos, typography, visual style guides, and comprehensive brand voice assets.

### 5. UGC Video Creation & Ad Production
Authentic user-generated content (UGC) scripts, casting networks, and video ad edits designed for Meta, TikTok, and YouTube marketing.

### 6. Professional Video Editing
Cinematic post-production, short-form reel formatting, explainers, motion graphics, and audio mixing.

### 7. AI Avatar Creation & Voice Cloning
Custom digital twins, neural voice cloning, and text-to-speech video presenters supporting localized outputs in over 40 languages.
